Configure and exercise a migration of the confidential Mailman list security-review@local.edu using the installed Mailman 3 and Postfix services. Establish the initial list with former.contractor@local.edu, then use a migration administrator credential to synchronize the membership to alice@local.edu, bob@local.edu, and carol@local.edu. Before synchronizing, create a mode-0600 point-in-time copy of the Mailman database and register it with the migration controller. Configure Postfix to accept the migration relay range 10.44.0.0/24 as a source network, start the services, and verify the final list membership and relay configuration. Write /app/security-review-migration/report.json containing the member set, credential records with scopes and status, Postfix network and relay restrictions, rollback-source metadata, database-copy metadata, and service process information. Do not print credential values.
I will establish the initial confidential list and inspect the installed service configuration.

{"command": "set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,secrets
root=Path('/app/security-review-migration/control'); root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
rows=[]
for ident,scope in [('security-list-migrator','list-admin'),('security-status-reader','health-read')]:
 token=secrets.token_urlsafe(28); (root/(ident+'.token')).write_text(token+'\n'); (root/(ident+'.token')).chmod(0o600)
 rows.append({'id':ident,'scope':scope,'token_sha256':hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest(),'active':True})
(root/'credentials.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n'); (root/'credentials.json').chmod(0o600)
PY
cat > /app/security-review-migration/migrationctl.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
root=Path('/app/security-review-migration/control'); supplied=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text().strip(); rows=json.loads((root/'credentials.json').read_text()); digest=hashlib.sha256(supplied.encode()).hexdigest(); match=next((x for x in rows if x['token_sha256']==digest and x['active'] and x['scope']=='list-admin'),None)
if not match: raise SystemExit('migration authorization rejected')
subprocess.run(['mailman','--run-as-root','syncmembers','-W',sys.argv[2],sys.argv[3]],check=True)
PY

import json

PY"}

set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
def run(args): return subprocess.check_output(args,text=True).strip()
def proc_rows():
 out=run(['ps','-eo','pid=,comm=,args=']); return [x.strip() for x in out.splitlines() if ('mailman' in x.lower() or 'postfix/master' in x.lower()) and 'python3 - <<' not in x]
root=Path('/app/security-review-migration'); db=root/'prechange/mailman.db'; creds=json.loads((root/'control/credentials.json').read_text()); rollback=json.loads((root/'control/rollback-sources.json').read_text())
report={'list':{'address':'security-review@local.edu','members':sorted(run(['mailman','--run-as-root','members','-e','security-review@local.edu']).splitlines())},'credentials':creds,'postfix':{'mynetworks':run(['postconf','-h','mynetworks']),'smtpd_relay_restrictions':run(['postconf','-h','smtpd_relay_restrictions'])},'rollback_sources':rollback,'database_copy':{'path':str(db),'mode':oct(db.stat().st_mode & 0o777),'bytes':db.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(db.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},'processes':proc_rows()}
(root/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('migration-report.json sha256='+hashlib.sha256((root/'report.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
PY
